name: Airsonic-advanced
tagline: A free, web-based media streamer, providing ubiquitious access to your music. Use it to share your music with friends, or to listen to your own music while at work. You can stream to multiple players simultaneously, for instance to one player in your kitchen and another in your living room.
description: Airsonic-advanced is a free, web-based media streamer, providing ubiquitious access to your music. Use it to share your music with friends, or to listen to your own music while at work. You can stream to multiple players simultaneously, for instance to one player in your kitchen and another in your living room.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/airsonic-advanced:11.1.4@sha256:a0945c317c94380f0f06abcbab36f49a13ad5c2741e26cd0fbc670a061ef5548
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
      CONTEXT_PATH: ''
      JAVA_OPTS: ''
    ports:
      - target: 4040
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/music
        target: /music
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/playlists
        target: /playlists
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/podcasts
        target: /podcasts
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/media
        target: /media
